Clause 2 (a developing map continuous for T_BTZ): for every y0 and every presentation Phi (one exists: conjunct 2, btz_exists_presentation) there is a datum d. Its T' is tamifying, chartwise Phi^*hornTop at every lifted descending E_0-chart (DEC-118 (c)), and natural over reg M, which fixes the neighbourhood filter at every point. Its D is T'-continuous, a developing map on p^-1(reg M), and an a.e. (G,X)-morphism into M^3 (isAEMorphismOf_dev). The reading is ruled; no hidden assumption carries the conclusion: d is built from btz_manifold_exists_chartwise_tamifying_reg, not assumed.

Clause 3 (M~ is a BTZ~-manifold, DEC-130 'full structure'): the instance BTZTildeData.singularGXStructure is a genuine maximal a.e. atlas (DEC-25) on (M~, T') — the pullback p^*B along the a.e. local homeomorphism p. That p is one is PROVED: isPortly_regSpace and isLocalHomeomorphOn_proj through retopBTZ. aeAtlas_space is rfl, and isAEMorphism_proj holds. reg_space (Reg = p^-1(reg M)) is a real theorem: rigidity on a preconnected lifted chart, then btzDevM_range_notMem_nhds. It is not a definitional identity. Each singular point gets a genuine XAChart: a homeomorphism U ≃ V onto a connected T_BTZ-open of E_0~, an a.e. morphism by isAEMorphism_of_developsCharts, centred in S = Sing(E_0~). The model E_0~ carries the same pullback structure (btzTildeModel), so the definition is not trivialised. The standing instances (T2 from Manifolds, LPC, first countable, connected) are proved.
